dvedhāvitakkasutta.p: [Dvedhāvitakka+sutta] (na) CL=8 Dvedhāvitakka sutta, sutta which is preached about two parts of Vitaka.
pn: Dvedhāvitakkasutta. Preached at Jetavana. The Buddha tells the monks how, before the Awakening, he divided his thoughts into two groups – the first being of pleasures of sense, of harm and of hurt, and the other thoughts of renunciation. He then proceeds to explain how this ultimately led to Awakening. MN.i.114ff.
